items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Whitman and - [INTERVIEWEE] As a matter of fact man, I had a trombone band at one time.

ctx.x: As a matter of fact man, I had a trombone band at one time. I’ve got the record here, man. I had four bones, and a singer, and a horn player, alto player, and a bass player. That was it.
